headline: UK approves long-stalled Jackdaw North Sea gas drilling project
summary: The UK government has approved the Jackdaw natural gas field off the coast of Scotland to lessen dependence on imported energy.
why: North Sea energy extraction projects dictate domestic energy supply security and capital expenditures for oil and gas producers operating in the region.

impacts.name: Energy & Utilities
impacts.why: New drilling permits increase domestic extraction potential and long-term asset value for participating energy firms.
